title: Helpers Around Us
hook: Helping works best when people know their job.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D community-helper storybook, respectful everyday service scenes, clear foregrounds; visual identity: Helpers Around Us

creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Helpers Around Us a role-and-scope map: design, build, health, emergency, information, maintenance, service, science, teaching, volunteering and inspection are distinct; helping does not erase professional training.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child asks what problem a role addresses and what training/boundary it needs, avoiding hero stereotypes.
